title: Spot gold after a US 10-year yield shock day

rule.shock: 10-year bond CFD daily return / sd of the 250 previous common-day returns, |z| >= 1.5
rule.baseline: same side and hold entered at every gold candle of the same year (mean)
rule.costs: $0.60 a round trip + nights() x FIN.xau.long on buys

tests.what: yield-up shock (10-year bond price z <= -1.5): buy gold at the next open, 5 candles (primary)
yield-down shock (bond z >= +1.5): sell gold at the next open, 5 candles
yield-up shock: buy gold at the next open, 1 candle
